{{Top|leg}}
A '''hydrogen turbine''' was a drive system for [[Water/Legends|waterbourne]] vessels, considered to be ancient by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Mounted on [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] A-frames, hydrogen turbines had a reputation for exploding.
